address: 368 Wenchang Middle Road, Guangling, Yangzhou, China Mainland
bio: A quiet oasis in the bustling city centre, Shuang Dong is tucked away in a non-descript alley near the historical Dongguan Street. The restaurant is extremely popular among locals on account of the wide array of well-made Huaiyang fare and local specialities it offers. With its bold flavours and rich sauces, the stinky tofu and pork intestine in sizzling hot pot is perfect with a bowl of steamed rice. Reserve a room for more privacy....
